confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Café, menu del día and restaurant anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is less certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. Beer is priced per 0.5 L equivalent, since Spanish bars usually serve smaller cañas.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on typical ordinary-venue prices in mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities such as Seville and Granada, adjusted for Malaga's coastal summer demand. No specific external source was used for the city-price anchors.
